identify: A storage hatch under the down-tube bottle mounts, tyres up to 34 mm, a rear bottle mount as standard; the old aero down-tube bottle does not fit. A Profile Design Wing cockpit with a 38 cm base bar on a Cervélo ST36 alloy stem.

cockpit.steerer: D-shaped steerer with a round stem interface (Cervélo); FSA IS2 headset 1-1/4 in top / 1-3/8 in bottom. Takes standard stems; one owner needed a shim to remove fork/steerer play with a BMC basebar sleeve.
cockpit.stem: Cervélo ST36 alloy stem: 70 mm (48/51), 80 mm (54/56), 90 mm (58/61); any standard stem can be fitted.
cockpit.stack_system: Stem spacers (up to 53 mm with the ones supplied) plus Profile Design risers under the pads. Ultegra Di2 and Force AXS builds (A2 bracket) take Profile Design A3 riser kits through the A2-to-A3 adaptor. Rival, 105 Di2 and 105 builds (Supersonic bracket) take 31.8 mm Supersonic risers, 5–70 mm, up to 80 mm in all. The top of Profile Design's pad-height chart needs these risers, bought separately.
cockpit.reach_system: Stem length first, then the Profile Design bracket and armrest positions (15 mm steps). On Supersonic builds the bracket can be reversed so the pads sit ahead of the base bar. On A2 builds the A3 Reach Extender adds about 30 mm.
cockpit.angle_system: Supersonic builds: tilt by rotating the bracket on the base bar. A2 builds: 0–15° with the bracket bolts, 18–30° with the A2 Tilt Booster.
cockpit.notes: Profile Design publishes a per-size Pad X/Y chart for this generation (2025 model) for both bracket types (see stock_range). Owners report the stock cable routing from basebar past the stem is untidy and that larger aftermarket stems foul the plastic cover in front of the bento.

evidence.says: For the P-Series with Wing 20C+ and A2 bracket, tilt 0-15 deg natively, 18-30 deg with the A2 Tilt Booster.

gaps: Stock range is read off Profile Design's Pad X/Y chart image for the '2025' P-Series (+/-5 mm); the chart does not state whether reach is to the back or centre of the pad, so pad_reference is 'unspecified'. Cervélo's own size finder reportedly uses back of pad, but cervelo.com returned HTTP 429 earlier and was not retried.

Stock riser fitting conflicts: Profile Design's guide lists 'Risers N/A' for Ultegra Di2/Force/Rival and 'Aerobar Risers' for 105 builds, while a US dealer spec lists an A3A low riser kit on Ultegra Di2 and a 30 mm bracket riser kit on 105/105 Di2/Rival. Check what came with the bike.
Profile Design maker pages (profile-design.com) returned HTTP 429, so no prices recorded; search snippets show USD-looking prices without a confirmed currency.
Exact stem clamp on the D-shaped steerer is described as a round interface by Cervélo; diameter (1-1/8 in) not confirmed in a document reached.
Profile Design Wing Ultimate basebar is on the guide's upgrade path but a PD staffer said it was not yet sold in North America (Dec 2025); not listed as a part.
TriRig Alpha One posts (May 2025) do not state the P-Series year; listed here because the 2025 thread discusses current bikes, but the stem is a standard part that also fits the 1st gen.
TriRig Super-X has a 'Profile Wing' plate (A3 risers required) but no source ties it to the P-Series Wing 10A/20C basebars; not listed.
